profile.name: Md Soykot Hossain Sarker
profile.summary: Urban planner by training, geospatial engineer by practice. I build the elevation models, land-cover classifications and automation tools that district development plans and Risk-Sensitive Land Use Plans in Bangladesh are drawn on.

sections.title: Study objective
sections.intro: Two tracks that started separately and have converged in my working life.

items.title: Planning
bullets: Five years of formal training in urban and regional planning (BURP, PUST) — land use law, zoning, transport, municipal finance, development control.
Currently drafting district development plans and Risk-Sensitive Land Use Plans for the Urban Development Directorate.
Member of the Bangladesh Institute of Planners.

items.title: Geoinformatics
bullets: UAV photogrammetry end to end — flight planning, GCP integration, orthomosaic, DSM and DTM extraction in Metashape and Pix4D.
Sentinel-2 and Landsat time series for land-cover classification, change detection and land surface temperature retrieval.
Python and PyQGIS automation; two plugins in production use.

sections.title: Peer-reviewed research
sections.intro: One journal article, co-authored as an undergraduate, now cited 46 times.

items.title: Thermal and ecological assessment based on land surface temperature in Bogura, Bangladesh
items.subtitle: Heliyon 7(9), e08012 · Elsevier
items.body: Tracked land surface temperature across Bogura Sadar from multitemporal Landsat imagery spanning 2001–2020 and quantified the environmental factors driving it. Mean LST rose 0.62 °C over twenty years.
bullets: Land cover classification across the full image series
Land surface temperature extraction via the radiative transfer equation
Thematic map production and spatial analysis

items.title: Undergraduate thesis — land use change and surface temperature
items.subtitle: Pabna University of Science & Technology
items.body: Analysed the pattern of land use / land cover change and quantified its effect on land surface temperature in Bogura Municipality using supervised classification and radiative-transfer LST retrieval.

sections.title: Professional experience
sections.intro: Three consecutive geospatial roles across a consultancy, a national research institute and a planning firm working for government.

items.title: Urban Planner
items.subtitle: Geomark Limited · Photogrammetry & Planning, Dhaka
bullets: Contribute to district development plans and Risk-Sensitive Land Use Plans for the Urban Development Directorate.
Build and maintain the physical feature, topographic and land use GIS databases those plans are drawn from.
Process UAV imagery into Digital Elevation and Digital Surface Models; produce base, zoning and field validation maps.
Lead the GIS team — train junior colleagues and review analytical output.

items.title: Junior GIS Analyst
items.subtitle: ACE Consultants Ltd · subsidiary of SMEC International, Dhaka
bullets: Processed UAV imagery into orthomosaics, DTMs and DSMs for topographic analysis.
Supported UAV data collection through flight planning and ground control point integration.
Wrote a QGIS plugin and Python tooling that automated a multi-step DSM / DTM extraction workflow.
Converted AutoCAD drawings into spatial data formats and ran QC on survey data.

items.title: Research Consultant
items.subtitle: CEGIS · Remote Sensing division, Dhaka
bullets: Classified land use and seasonal cropping patterns across southern Bangladesh from Sentinel-2 and Landsat imagery.
Produced detailed land use zoning maps from the classification results.
Managed project geodatabases and compiled spatial data for large-scale analysis.

items.title: Intern
items.subtitle: Ishwardi Municipality · Pabna
bullets: Assisted the Executive Engineer with coordination of building approval processes.
Supported development of a municipal dumping site project.

sections.title: Open-source tooling
sections.intro: Both tools were written to remove real bottlenecks on live consultancy projects, then released publicly.

items.title: DSM / DTM Extractor
items.subtitle: QGIS plugin · Python
items.body: Extracts Digital Surface and Digital Terrain Models according to project-specific preferences. Ten manual steps collapsed into one automated operation.

items.title: Mouza-Map Plot Numbering
items.subtitle: QGIS plugin · Python
items.body: Numbers cadastral plots sequentially across Mouza maps. Written for the Land Acquisition Plan at SMEC, then packaged as a plugin.

sections.title: Map portfolio
sections.intro: Cartographic and analytical output. Upload a map in the admin panel and describe the data, method and study area.

items.title: Land surface temperature, Bogura Municipality
items.subtitle: Bogura, Bangladesh
items.body: Mean land surface temperature retrieved via the radiative transfer equation across a twenty-year series, classified into thermal zones and overlaid on the municipal boundary. Example entry — replace the image and text with your own map.

items.title: Land use / land cover classification
items.subtitle: Southern Bangladesh
items.body: Supervised classification of seasonal cropping patterns from Sentinel-2 composites, validated against field survey points. Example entry — replace with your own map.
